title: How the Japan tour came about
summary: A colonel who was a fan arranged with a nightclub owner to bring the band to Japan for three months.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Beautiful! because right now, today, that's one of your hottest numbers that nobody ever gets tired of listening to that, especially me. Ahh - so things slide by, we are into 1960-61. A trip to Japan materializes. How did that come about?
Well, there was a Colonel that was a fan of my band from way back to Charlie Parker and so forth, and he had in mind to bring the band up there. But, naturally,

the army had enough money to bring a band up there, so he submitted the idea to a nightclub owner and they got together and they send a letter to my booking office, Curbelo, Jose Curbelo, and they made the arrangement and we went to Japan and we spent three months up there. It was a success.
